params.body:
The store locator lists every active sales point. A test shop has to stay active to be orderable, so it showed up on the public map.

The locator now leaves out sales points whose `showOnMap` ("Op de kaart", new in Hoet-design/hoet-sanity) is `false`. A missing value counts as on, so shops published before the field existed stay listed. The order flow is untouched: a shop off the map can still be picked when placing an order.

Test: `VerkooppuntAdresTest::test_a_shop_off_the_map_is_not_listed` renders the block with a shop off the map and checks that its name, street and country do not appear.

Full suite: 413 of 414 pass; BuildStampTest fails only in a git worktree.
params.title: Leave sales points with 'Op de kaart' off out of the store locator
